description: Task B opening move: ask for a context pack, then look up the command registration site.

args.request: Add a new built-in CLI command flask config that prints the loaded application's configuration as JSON, masking the values of any key containing SECRET, PASSWORD, TOKEN or KEY as "***". It must appear in flask --help, be covered by a test, and be documented alongside the other built-in commands.

steps.text: I have the context I need: cli.py (FlaskGroup registers built-in commands), tests/test_cli.py, docs/cli.rst and CHANGES.rst.
